nodes.label: ADR-0002 Job hunting is the primary domain
Decision: job hunting is the primary domain
nodes.rationale: Needs a live domain where facts change often, results are checkable and real users are reachable. Rejected: general assistant (too broad), finance first (overlaps ARGUS, advice risk), news first (no personal pilot). Revisit if fewer than 10 pilot users by 2027-03-31.
